state.seed_assertion: Even if a DPIA is not required on 25 May 2018, it will be necessary, at the appropriate time, for the controller to conduct such a DPIA as part of its general accountability obligations.

sentences.1: Even if a DPIA is not required on 25 May 2018, it will be necessary, at the appropriate time, for the controller to conduct such a DPIA as part of its general accountability obligations.
sentences.2: Therefore, even if a DPIA is not required on 25 May 2018, it will be necessary, at the appropriate time, for the controller to conduct such a DPIA as part of its general accountability obligations.
sentences.3: The DPIA should be conducted before the processing begins.
sentences.4: The DPIA should be conducted before the processing begins and should be considered as a living tool, not merely as a one-off exercise.
sentences.5: The DPIA should be conducted before the processing begins and should be considered as a living tool, not merely as a one-off exercise.
sentences.6: Article 35 of the GDPR prescribes that a Data Protection Impact Assessment shall be conducted by a controller where a type of data processing, in particular using new technologies, is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.7: Article 35 of the General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR") prescribes that a Data Protection Impact Assessment ("DPIA") shall be conducted by a controller where a type of data processing, in particular using new technologies, is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.8: The list of processing operations subject to DPIA is not exhaustive and does not remove or alter the obligation to conduct a DPIA in all cases where the conditions of article 35 par.1 of GDPR are met.
